meta.name: muapi-product-showcase-video
meta.description: Create a dynamic product showcase with explosive ingredient arrangements, followed by a realistic motion animation.

copy.tagline: 将产品素材自动生成动态展示视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作产品展示视频但缺乏动画设计能力
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate dynamic product showcase videos from assets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need product showcase videos but lack animation skills

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会先根据产品照片和配料描述生成一张动态广告图，然后把它转成一段慢动作动画视频。
howto.when: 当你上传产品照片，并说明想展示的配料和品牌颜色时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这款果汁做一个配料飞散的展示视频。
say.note: Claude 会要求你上传产品照片。

say.text: 用这张咖啡照片，搭配可可粉和牛奶，生成动态广告动画。
say.note: Claude 会先出图，确认后再生成视频。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a dynamic ad image from a product photo and ingredient description, then turns it into a slow-motion animation video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a product photo and optionally specify ingredients and brand colors.

say_en.text: Create a showcase video for this juice with flying ingredients.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the product photo.

say_en.text: Use this coffee photo with cocoa and milk to make a dynamic ad animation.
say_en.note: Claude will first generate an image, then animate it.
